name: taskattest
description: Stop a coding agent from finishing with changes outside its task. A Stop hook checks what it changed against the files it may touch (your own uncommitted work is never blamed on it), what it produced (invented records, wrong totals, CSV/Excel), and, only if you approved them, the commands you name. Blocks with a structured fix, hands over to you after repeated failures, leaves an evidence bundle. No model calls, no dependencies.

python.title: Python command
python.description: Python 3.10 or newer, as a command on PATH or a full path. On Windows `python3` is often the Store stub; use `python` or the full path to python.exe.
